title: 68% or 18%? Who is counting? #shorts
description:
68% of items on big trips were decided in the store (Inman & Winer, 1999: 4,200 shoppers, 14 US cities); 18% of categories (Bell, Corsten & Knox, Netherlands, 2006 data). Items and categories are different yardsticks (FACT).

The whole story: https://www.youtube.com/@zerounderstands

#shorts #howitworks #supermarket
